instructions: Use dated work in state.cv and ${args_path}.scope to choose total documented relevant work duration. An empty scope means overall work. Include paid apprenticeships only when ${args_path}.include_paid_apprenticeships is true. Count overlapping periods once. Present means state.reference_date. Do not infer that a listed skill was used throughout a role or substitute an undated summary claim for dated work. Zero evidenced duration belongs to under_1, not proof of no experience. Use elapsed duration, not an inclusive count of calendar-year numbers. Do not round a partial calendar year up to a whole year. Subtract stated gaps. The total cannot exceed the elapsed time from the earliest relevant work start to state.reference_date.

criteria.under_1: Less than one year of documented relevant work, including zero evidenced duration.
criteria.1_to_under_3: At least one but less than three years of documented relevant work.
criteria.3_to_under_5: At least three but less than five years of documented relevant work.
criteria.5_to_under_8: At least five but less than eight years of documented relevant work.
criteria.8_plus: At least eight years of documented relevant work.
